```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(encoding = "UTF-8")
if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  utf8_locale <- Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "Chinese_China.utf8")
  if (!nzchar(utf8_locale)) stop("A UTF-8 Windows locale is required to render this report.", call. = FALSE)
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)
bootstrap <- c(file.path("scripts", "helpers", "workflow_helpers.R"),
  file.path("test", "ablation-03", "scripts", "helpers", "workflow_helpers.R"))
bootstrap <- bootstrap[file.exists(bootstrap)][1L]
if (is.na(bootstrap)) stop("Run from ablation-03 or the repository root.", call. = FALSE)
source(bootstrap, local = TRUE)
source(.ablation03_path("02.01.00. 表示分析_functions.R"), local = TRUE)
source(.ablation03_path("scripts", "helpers", "nature_colors.R"))
source(.ablation03_path("scripts", "helpers", "nature_theme.R"))
source(.ablation03_path("scripts", "helpers", "plot_delivery_helpers.R"))
source(.ablation03_path("scripts", "helpers", "datatables_helper.R"))

fmt <- function(x, digits = 3L) formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "f")
fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1L) paste0(fmt(100 * x, digits), "%")
fmt_p <- function(x) ifelse(is.finite(x), format.pval(x, digits = 3, eps = 1e-3), "NA")
fmt_ci <- function(x) paste0("[", fmt(x$ci_low), ", ", fmt(x$ci_high), "]")
analysis_name <- basename(.ablation03_path())
structure_report_name <- "02.03.00. 结构复现分析"
biology_input_script_name <- "01.03.00. 生物输入准备.R"
biology_script_name <- "02.02.00. 生物锚点分析.R"
biology_functions_name <- "02.02.00. 生物锚点分析_functions.R"
result_dir <- .wf_output("ablation-experiment")
.wf_validate(result_dir)
manifest <- readRDS(file.path(result_dir, "manifest.rds"))
.wf_validate(.wf_output("ablation-biology"))
biology_dir <- .wf_output("ablation-biology")
biology_files <- file.path(
  biology_dir,
  c("anchor_coverage.csv", "anchor_utility.csv", "anchor_contrasts.csv",
    "anchor_inference.csv", "anchor_cohort_deltas.csv",
    "anchor_missing_pairs.csv", "ablation03-biology.rds")
)
biology_available <- all(file.exists(biology_files))
if (!biology_available) {
  stop("Biology report requires all completed target products, including cohort deltas.",
    call. = FALSE)
}
if (biology_available) {
  biology_coverage <- read.csv(biology_files[1L], check.names = FALSE)
  biology_utility <- read.csv(biology_files[2L], check.names = FALSE)
  biology_contrasts <- read.csv(biology_files[3L], check.names = FALSE)
  biology_inference <- read.csv(biology_files[4L], check.names = FALSE)
  biology_cohort <- read.csv(biology_files[5L], check.names = FALSE)
  biology_missing <- read.csv(biology_files[6L], check.names = FALSE)
  biology_result <- readRDS(biology_files[7L])
  table_dir <- .ablation03_report_path("tables")
  dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  utils::write.csv(
    biology_inference,
    file.path(table_dir, "02.02.00. anchor-inference.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  utils::write.csv(
    biology_cohort,
    file.path(table_dir, "02.02.00. anchor-cohort-deltas.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
} else {
  biology_coverage <- data.frame()
  biology_utility <- data.frame()
  biology_contrasts <- data.frame()
  biology_inference <- data.frame()
  biology_cohort <- data.frame()
  biology_missing <- data.frame()
}
biology_status <- if (biology_available && nrow(biology_utility) > 0L &&
  nrow(biology_inference) > 0L) {
  "complete"
} else {
  "not_estimable"
}
biology_inference_estimable <- biology_inference[
  biology_inference$inference_status == "estimable",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
biology_inference_summary <- if (nrow(biology_inference_estimable) > 0L) {
  paste0(
    nrow(biology_inference_estimable), " 个达到预设 cohort 门槛的 anchor，",
    "其 cohort 等权效应范围为 ",
    fmt(min(biology_inference_estimable$estimate)), " 至 ",
    fmt(max(biology_inference_estimable$estimate))
  )
} else {
  "没有 anchor 达到预设 cohort 门槛；当前点估计仅作描述"
}
biology_signal_pool <- if (nrow(biology_inference_estimable) > 0L) {
  biology_inference_estimable
} else {
  biology_inference
}
biology_top_signal <- biology_signal_pool[
  which.max(abs(biology_signal_pool$estimate)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
preview_dir <- bensz_run_dir(bensz_preview_root(params$plot_run_dir),
  prefix = "02.02.00-biology")
figure_dir <- .ablation03_report_path("figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
anchor_order <- names(biology_result$anchors)
if (!setequal(anchor_order, biology_inference$anchor) ||
    !setequal(anchor_order, biology_cohort$anchor)) {
  stop("Biology report anchor sets differ across target products.", call. = FALSE)
}
cohort_means <- stats::aggregate(delta_d1_minus_direct ~ anchor,
  data = biology_cohort, FUN = mean)
matched_estimates <- biology_inference$estimate[
  match(cohort_means$anchor, biology_inference$anchor)]
if (!isTRUE(all.equal(cohort_means$delta_d1_minus_direct,
    matched_estimates, tolerance = 1e-10))) {
  stop("Cohort deltas do not reproduce the inference estimates.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (anyNA(biology_cohort$query_count) ||
    any(biology_cohort$query_count < 1L)) {
  stop("Biology cohort cells must contain paired queries.", call. = FALSE)
}
external_coverage <- biology_coverage[
  biology_coverage$external_query_cohort, , drop = FALSE]
external_cohort_count <- length(unique(external_coverage$cohort_key))
partial_external_count <- sum(external_coverage$coverage < 1)
missing_pair_count <- sum(biology_missing$missing_score_pairs)
cohort_negative_fraction <- mean(biology_cohort$delta_d1_minus_direct < 0)
plot_zh <- identical(params$plot_language, "zh")
plot_label <- function(en, zh) if (plot_zh) zh else en
```

本报告是 `r analysis_name` 实验的生物学分析模块；只读取已经完成的邻居检索与 anchor 评估结果。

## 数据概览

候选外部队列为 `r manifest$external_candidate_cohort_count` 个，表达覆盖审计包含 `r nrow(biology_coverage)` 行。实际有效 query 由两臂 top-`r 15L` 分数完整性共同决定。

## 关键函数、参数与源代码位置

| 过程 | 函数与参数 | 约定 | 源代码 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 表达输入准备 | signature 名称与完整样本契约 | 在分析前提取表达子集 | `r biology_input_script_name` |
| 连续评分 | reference gene-wise z-score | 对两臂应用同一 reference 尺度 | `r biology_script_name` |
| 配对推断 | `.biology_paired_contrast()`；`r params$inference_bootstrap` 次 bootstrap；至少 `r 3L` 个 cohort | 先按 query 配对，再以 cohort 为独立单位；仅对达到门槛的 anchor 计算区间、P 值与 BH 校正 | `r biology_functions_name` |

## 指标导读

| 指标 | 定义与边界 |
|---|---|
| Anchor utility | `exp(-绝对分数差)`，越高表示邻居的连续表达分数越接近；不是临床效用 |
| d1−Direct | cohort 等权的配对差；正值表示 d1 的 utility 较高 |
| `r "95%"` CI 与 BH 校正 P 值 | cohort bootstrap 区间与组内多重比较；CI 跨零不证明等价 |

双侧 sign-flip 检验在 cohort 数不超过 `r 18L` 时枚举符号组合，否则采用 Monte Carlo 加一校正；保留原有统计实现与 seed。

## 连续表达锚点 readout

四个 anchor 按配置中的 signature 名称精确选取；它们独立于癌种标签，但来自表达数据，不能视为独立测量的临床结局。完整 reference 样本拟合 gene-wise z-score，再应用到两侧。每个 query 在两臂均有完整 top-`r 15L` 分数时才进入配对比较。

### 锚点基因覆盖

```{r figure-biology-anchor-coverage, echo=FALSE, interp_check=TRUE}
fig_coverage <- list(width_in = 8.4, height_in = 5.8, base_size = 10,
  point_size = 1.6, median_size = 2.8)
coverage_plot <- biology_coverage
coverage_plot$anchor <- factor(coverage_plot$anchor, levels = anchor_order)
coverage_plot$analysis_set <- factor(
  ifelse(coverage_plot$external_query_cohort, "External query", "Reference"),
  levels = c("External query", "Reference")
)
coverage_plot$coverage_state <- ifelse(
  coverage_plot$status != "estimable", "Not estimable",
  ifelse(coverage_plot$coverage < 1, "Partial gene set", "Full gene set")
)
coverage_plot$coverage_state <- factor(coverage_plot$coverage_state,
  levels = c("Full gene set", "Partial gene set", "Not estimable"))
coverage_median <- stats::aggregate(coverage ~ anchor + analysis_set,
  data = coverage_plot, FUN = median)
p_coverage <- ggplot2::ggplot(coverage_plot,
  ggplot2::aes(x = .data$coverage, y = .data$analysis_set)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(color = .data$analysis_set, shape = .data$coverage_state),
    position = ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.14, seed = 20260924L),
    size = fig_coverage$point_size, alpha = 0.62
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = coverage_median,
    shape = 18, size = fig_coverage$median_size, color = "black") +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~anchor, ncol = 2) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.02),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "External query" = nature_colors[["navy"]], "Reference" = "grey65"
  ), guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "Full gene set" = 16, "Partial gene set" = 1, "Not estimable" = 4
  )) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = plot_label("Signature gene coverage", "签名基因覆盖率"), y = NULL,
    color = plot_label("Analysis set", "分析集合"),
    shape = plot_label("Coverage state", "覆盖状态"),
    caption = plot_label("Dots: cohorts; black diamonds: medians.",
      "圆点：队列；黑色菱形：中位数。")
  ) +
  theme_nature_readable(base_size = fig_coverage$base_size,
    legend_position = "bottom")
coverage_jpg <- .ae_save_plot(p_coverage,
  "02.02.00. anchor-gene-coverage", figure_dir, preview_dir,
  fig_coverage, params$plot_preview_dpi)
knitr::include_graphics(coverage_jpg)
```

解读：外部 query 包含 `r external_cohort_count` 个 cohort × `r length(anchor_order)` 个锚点组合，其中 `r partial_external_count` 个组合的基因覆盖率未达到 100%；缺失分数邻居对共 `r missing_pair_count` 个。覆盖率只说明签名基因在表达数据中是否可用，不代表邻居效用，也不能证明锚点与模型输入独立。

```{r biology-anchor-coverage, echo=FALSE}
biology_coverage_widget <- htmltools::tagList()
if (identical(biology_status, "complete")) {
  biology_coverage_widget <- render_dt(biology_coverage, pageLength = 10)
}
biology_coverage_widget
```

解读：当前结果显示，coverage 表保留 `r nrow(biology_coverage)` 行 anchor/cohort 覆盖信息。实际基因覆盖与有效 query 范围共同决定可解释性；高覆盖也不意味着 signature 与 CCS 输入完全独立。表格展示的是基因集合能否被当前表达数据支持，提示不同队列可用的基因子集可能不同。覆盖不足会影响分数含义，不能只看最终均值；后续若发现极端效应，应同时核对该队列的基因覆盖和缺失邻居数量。

```{r biology-anchor-utility, echo=FALSE}
biology_utility_widget <- htmltools::tagList()
if (identical(biology_status, "complete")) {
  biology_utility_widget <- render_dt(biology_utility, pageLength = 10)
}
biology_utility_widget
```

解读：当前结果显示，表中 `r nrow(biology_utility)` 行给出同一批完整配对 query 的分臂 utility。较高值表示连续表达分数更接近。此处分臂样本均值及样本重采样的 95% 置信区间用于描述，两臂差异的正式比较使用下面 cohort 等权差及其区间。这里展示连续锚点的一致程度，而非旧癌种标签的一致程度。样本较多的队列会影响单臂样本均值；其区间没有处理队列内依赖，不能用来判断向新队列推广的精度，主要结论应以配对后队列等权的推断为准。

### 配对效应与不确定性

```{r figure-biology-anchor-inference, echo=FALSE, interp_check=TRUE}
fig_inference <- list(width_in = 9.2, height_in = 4.7, base_size = 10,
  point_size = 2.8, line_size = 0.8)
inference_plot <- biology_inference
inference_plot$anchor <- factor(inference_plot$anchor,
  levels = rev(anchor_order))
inference_plot$summary <- paste0(
  "n=", inference_plot$cohort_count,
  " | q=", format(inference_plot$query_count, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
  " | BH p", ifelse(is.na(inference_plot$p_value_adj), "=NA",
    ifelse(inference_plot$p_value_adj < 0.001, "<0.001",
      paste0("=", formatC(inference_plot$p_value_adj,
        digits = 3L, format = "f"))))
)
effect_limits <- range(c(inference_plot$estimate,
  inference_plot$ci_low, inference_plot$ci_high, 0), na.rm = TRUE)
label_x <- effect_limits[2L] + max(0.012, diff(effect_limits) * 0.12)
right_padding <- max(0.10, diff(effect_limits) * 1.1)
p_inference <- ggplot2::ggplot(inference_plot,
  ggplot2::aes(x = .data$estimate, y = .data$anchor)) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.55) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(xmin = .data$ci_low,
    xmax = .data$ci_high), orientation = "y",
    linewidth = fig_inference$line_size, na.rm = TRUE) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(shape = .data$inference_status),
    size = fig_inference$point_size, color = nature_colors[["navy"]]) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(x = label_x, label = .data$summary),
    hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "grey25") +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "estimable" = 16, "not_estimable" = 1
  ), guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(effect_limits[1L] - 0.01,
    label_x + right_padding), clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = plot_label("Cohort-equal paired utility difference (d1 - Direct)",
      "队列等权配对效用差（d1 − Direct）"), y = NULL,
    caption = plot_label(
      "Points: cohort-equal estimates; lines: 95% cohort bootstrap CI; dashed line: zero.",
      "圆点：队列等权估计；线段：95% 队列 bootstrap 区间；虚线：零差值。")
  ) +
  theme_nature_readable(base_size = fig_inference$base_size,
    legend_position = "none")
inference_jpg <- .ae_save_plot(p_inference,
  "02.02.00. anchor-paired-effect", figure_dir, preview_dir,
  fig_inference, params$plot_preview_dpi)
knitr::include_graphics(inference_jpg)
```

解读：`r biology_inference_summary`。正值表示 d1 的邻居锚点分数更接近，负值表示 Direct 更接近。区间基于 cohort bootstrap；P 值采用 paired sign-flip 并对可推断锚点做 BH 校正。Monte Carlo P 值受 `r biology_inference$n_boot[1L]` 次模拟的分辨率限制，因此图中只显示到 `<0.001`，不用星号代替效应大小。

### 队列间效应分布

```{r figure-biology-cohort-heterogeneity, echo=FALSE, interp_check=TRUE}
fig_cohort <- list(width_in = 9.1, height_in = 11.2, base_size = 9)
cohort_levels <- sort(unique(biology_cohort$query_cohort))
cohort_grid <- expand.grid(
  query_cohort = cohort_levels, anchor = anchor_order,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
cohort_plot <- merge(cohort_grid, biology_cohort,
  by = c("query_cohort", "anchor"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
cohort_plot$query_cohort <- factor(cohort_plot$query_cohort,
  levels = rev(cohort_levels))
cohort_plot$anchor <- factor(cohort_plot$anchor, levels = anchor_order)
color_limit <- max(abs(biology_cohort$delta_d1_minus_direct))
if (!is.finite(color_limit) || color_limit == 0) color_limit <- 0.01
p_cohort <- ggplot2::ggplot(cohort_plot,
  ggplot2::aes(x = .data$anchor, y = .data$query_cohort,
    fill = .data$delta_d1_minus_direct)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = nature_colors[["navy"]], mid = "white",
    high = nature_colors[["orange"]], midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-color_limit, color_limit), na.value = "grey85",
    name = plot_label("d1 - Direct", "d1 − Direct")
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL,
    y = plot_label("External query cohort", "外部 query 队列")
  ) +
  theme_nature_readable(base_size = fig_cohort$base_size,
    legend_position = "right") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9, angle = 20, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )
cohort_jpg <- .ae_save_plot(p_cohort,
  "02.02.00. anchor-cohort-heterogeneity", figure_dir, preview_dir,
  fig_cohort, params$plot_preview_dpi)
knitr::include_graphics(cohort_jpg)
```

解读：热图每格纳入 `r min(biology_cohort$query_count)` 至 `r max(biology_cohort$query_count)` 个配对 query，`r fmt_pct(cohort_negative_fraction)` 的可估计格子为负值。颜色展示队列内平均差，不给单个格子做显著性判断；完整队列名称、两臂均值、差值与 query 数保存在同批次的 `anchor_cohort_deltas.csv` 中。

```{r biology-anchor-inference, echo=FALSE}
biology_inference_widget <- htmltools::tagList()
if (identical(biology_status, "complete")) {
  biology_inference_widget <- render_dt(
    biology_inference[, c(
      "anchor", "estimate", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_value",
      "p_value_adj", "p_method", "cohort_count", "query_count",
      "min_cohorts", "inference_status"
    )],
    pageLength = 10
  )
}
biology_inference_widget
```

解读：当前结果显示，`r biology_inference_summary`。每个 query 先与自身的另一臂配对，然后计算 cohort 均值，避免缺失样本组成改变效应；BH 校正仅覆盖达到门槛的 anchor。未达门槛的行保留描述性点估计，但区间和 P 值为 NA。表中展示每个锚点的效应、区间与多重比较结果，提示统计显著性和生物学意义需要分开判断。较小但稳定的差异仍可能只是表达排序的局部代价；它是否影响生物状态识别，需要在明确的独立任务上检验。

## 讨论与分析

当前结果显示，表达覆盖审计包含 `r nrow(biology_coverage)` 行，实际 utility 表包含 `r nrow(biology_utility)` 行完整配对结果；两者共同限定可解释样本范围。

当前结果显示，`r biology_inference_summary`。这些结果衡量局部邻居的表达接近程度，不能直接推出整体结构保留或临床效用；跨队列的状态结构另见 `r structure_report_name` 报告。

当前结果显示，最强信号为 `r biology_top_signal$anchor`，cohort 等权 d1−Direct 差为 `r fmt(biology_top_signal$estimate)`，参与 `r biology_top_signal$cohort_count` 个 cohort；这里的“最强”仅按当前可用点估计绝对值排序。该信号的 CI 为 `r paste0("[", fmt(biology_top_signal$ci_low), ", ", fmt(biology_top_signal$ci_high), "]")`，并由 `r params$inference_bootstrap` 次 cohort bootstrap 描述不确定性；若未达到推断门槛，区间为 NA，点估计仍只作描述。

表达 anchor 与模型输入具有共同的数据来源，且缺失覆盖会限制有效样本范围。后续应在预先选定的独立 pathway、治疗反应或结局上检验效用，并报告每个 anchor 的有效 cohort 和 query 范围。

## 数字准确性验证

| 核查 | 当前证据 |
|---|---|
| 来源 | 当前 anchor CSV/RDS 与表示分析的来源凭据逐项核验 |
| 配对 | 两臂各有完整 top-`r 15L` 后按同一 query 配对 |
| 独立单位 | cohort 等权效应与 cohort bootstrap；BH 校正 |
| 数字 | 正文动态读取当前 `biology_inference`，未复制历史结果 |
